questions.question: At which ground did Jenna Evans record their career-best bowling figures (4-18, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval, against Knights on 2024/10/05.

questions.question: "Tuskers" is the current name for which former provincial union?
questions.explanation: KwaZulu-Natal Inland was rebranded Tuskers (KwaZulu-Natal Coastal became the Dolphins).

questions.question: Who topped the wickets charts in the 13/14 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Cara le Roux led with 9 wickets.
